summary:
迪爾公司最新季度財報表現強勁，每股盈餘超越市場預期，營收年增率維持穩健。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為5.10美元，優於預期的4.71美元，驚喜度達8.30%。
• 營收達到123.5億美元，較去年同期成長4.83%。
• 本益比維持在37.67倍，反映市場對其長期成長潛力的持續信心。
• 工業板塊中展現出穩健的營運韌性與成本控管能力。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報優於預期展現基本面韌性，對中短期股價具正面支撐；追蹤指標應關注農產品價格走勢、經銷商庫存水位及全球資本支出變化。

需留意：全球農具需求可能受到宏觀經濟與農產品價格波動的影響。；供應鏈成本上升與利率環境可能對未來利潤率造成壓力。

summary_en:
Deere & Company reported strong quarterly results with EPS beating expectations and solid year-over-year revenue growth.
• EPS came in at $5.10, beating the estimated $4.71 with a surprise of 8.30%.
• Revenue reached $12.35B, representing a 4.83% increase year-over-year.
• Trailing P/E ratio stands at 37.67, reflecting market confidence in long-term potential.
• Demonstrated solid operational resilience and cost management within the industrials sector.

View: The earnings beat demonstrates fundamental resilience, providing positive support for near-to-mid-term stock prices; key metrics to track include crop price trends, dealer inventory levels, and global capital expenditure changes.

Watch：Global agricultural equipment demand may be affected by macroeconomic volatility and fluctuating crop prices.; Rising supply chain costs and high interest rate environments could pressure future profit margins.
